# Dimension: Billing — Claude Subscription vs API Pricing

The core question: can Hermes Agent be backed by a Claude Code / Claude Pro-Max
subscription, or is it Anthropic **API pay-per-token only**? Sources in
[citations.md](../citations.md).

## Direct answer

**For Anthropic Claude: API key (pay-per-token) — not a Pro/Max subscription.** A Claude
Pro or Max subscription cannot legitimately back Hermes Agent. There *is* a "subscription"
you can use, but it is **Nous Portal** (Nous Research's own credit gateway), not your
Anthropic subscription.

## Why the subscription path is closed

Hermes' provider doc *lists* a Claude subscription-reuse path — "OAuth (requires Claude
Max + extra usage credits)" and "Claude Code credential reuse" (`--provider claude-code`)
[2]. But this collides with Anthropic policy:

1. **Anthropic banned subscription OAuth in third-party tools.** Free/Pro/Max OAuth
   tokens "cannot be used outside Claude Code and Claude.ai"; the alternative is "API key
   authentication issued through Claude Console or a supported cloud provider" [15].
   Effective **Feb 20, 2026** (policy) [15]; **technical block from Apr 4, 2026** for "all
   third-party agentic tools," naming OpenClaw and OpenCode [16]. Hermes Agent is exactly
   such a third-party harness.
2. **Anthropic's own support doc** says a subscription covers Claude Code in Anthropic's
   first-party surfaces and *supported IDEs only* (VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains) — it grants
   **no general permission** for arbitrary third-party tools. Setting `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
   switches Claude Code to **API billing**, not subscription usage [12].
3. **Corroboration (internal):** OAuth access tokens are rejected at
   `api.anthropic.com/v1/messages` ("OAuth authentication is currently not supported"),
   and Agent-SDK programmatic auth is `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, not OAuth — see
   [claude-code-oauth-quota](../../claude-code-oauth-quota/).

So the `--provider claude-code` line in Hermes' docs [2] is best read as **stale or
ToS-violating** for Pro/Max subscriptions post-April-2026. The compliant Claude paths are
an **Anthropic API key**, a **cloud provider** (Bedrock/Vertex), or **Nous Portal**.

## "Subscription" that *does* work: Nous Portal

Nous Portal is a "unified subscription gateway" — one OAuth login, one credit balance,
300+ models including Claude Opus 4.7/4.6, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5 [3]. You pay **Nous**
(credits), and Nous brokers the underlying model. This is the legitimate subscription-like
experience for Hermes; it does not rely on (or violate) your Anthropic subscription.
Per-token/credit rates were **not published** on the fetched page [3].

## Cost reality (Anthropic API, pay-per-token)

Hermes Agent is free (MIT); you pay only LLM usage [6]. Anthropic per-MTok base rates
(primary [13]):

| Model | Input $/MTok | Output $/MTok |
|-------|--------------|---------------|
| Opus 4.8 / 4.7 / 4.6 | $5 | $25 |
| Sonnet 4.6 / 4.5 | $3 | $15 |
| Haiku 4.5 | $1 | $5 |
| Opus 4.1 / 4 (deprecated) | $15 | $75 |

Discounts: prompt-cache hits at 0.1× input; Batch API 50% off [13]. Subscriptions: Pro
$20/mo (or $200/yr), Max from $100/mo [14].

### Contradiction surfaced — the widely-cited "$675/mo" figure is stale

Source [16] computes a heavy Opus-4.6 agent (500K input + 200K output tokens/day) at
**~$675/mo vs $200 Max (≈3.4×)** — but it priced Opus 4.6 at **$15/$75**, which is the
**deprecated Opus 4 / 4.1** rate, not current Opus 4.6 ($5/$25) [13]. Recomputed at
current rates:

```
(0.5 MTok × $5)  + (0.2 MTok × $25)  = $2.50 + $5.00 = $7.50/day
$7.50/day × 30 = ~$225/month (est.)
```

So that same workload is **~$225/mo (est.)**, roughly at par with a $200 Max plan — *not*
3.4× more. Caveat: Opus 4.7+ use a new tokenizer that "may use up to 35% more tokens for
the same fixed text" [13], nudging effective cost toward **~$255–305/mo (est.)**. Sonnet
4.6 for the same volume is **~$4.50/day ≈ $135/mo (est.)**. The headline lesson from
[15][16] — losing the subscription discount raises cost — still holds directionally, but
the magnitude in [16] is overstated by ~3× for current models.

## Decision table

| You want… | Use | Allowed? | Cost basis |
|-----------|-----|----------|-----------|
| Claude via your Pro/Max subscription | `--provider claude-code` OAuth reuse | **No** (blocked since Apr 2026) [15][16] | — |
| Claude, compliant, simplest | Anthropic **API key** (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) | Yes | Pay-per-token [12][13] |
| Claude, enterprise cloud | AWS Bedrock / Azure Foundry | Yes | Cloud per-token [2] |
| One subscription, many models incl. Claude | **Nous Portal** OAuth | Yes (Nous credits) | Credit balance, rate unpublished [3] |
| Zero LLM cost | Self-hosted vLLM/SGLang/Ollama | Yes | Infra only [2][6] |

## Gaps and Limitations

- Ban effective-date conflict (Feb 20 vs Apr 4) — see [citations.md](../citations.md)
  gaps. Underlying Anthropic Usage Policy not fetched as a standalone primary.
- Nous Portal pricing unpublished [3]; cost comparisons there are not possible.
- Cost recompute is an (est.) on an illustrative workload, not a measured Hermes trace.
